title: Karnataka High Court Halts Cruelty FIR Against Husband, Notes Similar Case Over Allegedly Restricting Wife's Beauty Parlour Visits Was Stayed
description: The Karnataka High Court on Friday (July 17) stayed the investigation and inquiry in a cruelty case registered against a husband, noting that the allegations in the FIR were a "translated version" of an earlier domestic violence complaint that had already been stayed by the Court. A single-judge Bench of Justice M. Nagaprasanna passed the interim order in a petition filed by a BESCOM employee accused of offences under Sections 85 (cruelty by husband or relatives), 115(2), 351(2) and 352 of the B
